_readme: Hand-typed extras per event. Key = LEAGUE|Split (split is empty for international events, e.g. "MSI|"). Optional fields: prize (text, e.g. "$1,000,000"), groups (object: group name -> list of team codes), mvp (player name, overrides the rating-based pick).
_notes: LPL groups: Split 1 Ascend/Nirvana from the published format, Perseverance = the remaining four teams (matches who played whom in the data). Split 2 = top 8 / bottom 6 of Split 1, Split 3 = top 8 / bottom 4 of Split 2; both match the schedule data.
